gloss: family register copy; certified copy of family register

definitions.explanation: An official document that contains all entries in a family register ({戸籍|こせき}), including family members' names, dates of birth, marriages, and other vital records. Required for various legal and administrative procedures.

examples.japanese: {戸籍謄本|こせきとうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる→取り寄せる：26804_toriyoseru⟧。
examples.english: To obtain a copy of the family register.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戸籍謄本|こせきとうほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{要|い}る→要る：09589_iru⟧。
examples.english: A family register copy is needed for a passport application.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧や⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戸籍謄本|こせきとうほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Submission of a family register copy is required for marriage and inheritance procedures.

notes:
COMPONENTS: ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧ (family register) + ⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧ (certified copy). The ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧ system is Japan's official civil registration system that records family relationships.

{戸籍謄本|こせきとうほん} contains records for ALL members of a family unit. For a copy showing only one individual, you request a ⟦{戸籍抄本|こせきしょうほん}→戸籍抄本：17495_kosekishouhon⟧ (partial extract).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧ — passport application
- ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ — marriage registration
- ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ — inheritance procedures
- ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧ — visa application

Obtained from the ⟦{本籍地|ほんせきち}→本籍地：16666_honsekichi⟧ (registered domicile) municipality, which may be different from where one currently lives. Can also be requested by mail or through convenience store terminals with a My Number card.
